name: Copy button
summary: A button that copies a fixed string or the text of another element to the clipboard.
description: Use it next to things people paste elsewhere: code, API keys, invite links. The label reads Copied for two seconds, then goes back. If the browser blocks the clipboard, the target text is selected so Ctrl+C still works.

states.description: On an icon-only copy button this is the text that changes to Copied, so screen readers hear it too.

hooks.name: data-v-copy
hooks.value: The text to copy. Leave it empty when data-v-copy-target is set.
hooks.description: Turns the button into a copy button. Always needed, even with a target.

hooks.name: data-v-copy-target
hooks.description: Copies the textContent of the element it points at instead of the data-v-copy value.

keyboard.action: Copies, and the label reads Copied for two seconds.

a11y: The result is announced through Vectra's live region: "Copied to clipboard", or a note that the text is selected when copying fails.
The visible label changes too (the last text node, or aria-label on an icon button), so sighted users get the same feedback.
Keep a real text label or an aria-label such as "Copy API key"; a bare icon gives no name.

examples.title: Copy a value
examples.html: <button class="v-btn v-btn-secondary" type="button" data-v-copy="npm install @creativeigniter/vectra"><svg class="v-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="/icons/sprite.svg#copy"/></svg>Copy install command</button>

examples.title: Copy another element
examples.description: data-v-copy-target points at the element whose text is copied.
